Eaton does not report data-center revenue as a separate segment, so the size of this business for the company is not disclosed.

Medium-voltage switchgear and large transformer lead times stretched past 52 weeks, developers said, and several hyperscale projects were re-sequenced around equipment delivery dates; this is one news report.
Northfield Thermal, a coolant distribution unit maker, is privately held, so it is not a listed company with a symbol here.
Eaton's disclosed order growth is not shown to be large enough to matter to its results; its revenue exposure to data centers is unresolved.
